articleTitle: Model Research on Forecast of Second-Hand House Price in Chengdu Based on XGboost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In order to better and more accurately study the housing price of second-hand houses, this paper analyzed and studied 35417 pieces of data captured by Chengdu HOME LINK network. Firstly, the captured data were cleaned and the characteristics were selected. Then, multiple linear regression, decision tree and XGboost models were used to fit the predicted housing price score curve for these ten factors, and finally, the optimal prediction model was selected through parameter adjustment. The experimental results show that the accuracy of XGboost prediction is the highest, and the prediction accuracy score reaches 0.9251. Compared with linear regression and decision tree model, XGboost algorithm has better generalization ability and robustness in data prediction, and also prevents overfitting phenomenon, laying a solid foundation for the subsequent second-hand house price prediction.

articleTitle: Applying Deep Learning to Balancing Network Intrusion Detection Datasets
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In this investigation, we apply deep learning to generate a desirable data generation model which helps to balance the network intrusion detection datasets and enhance the detection performance. The basic idea is to adopt deep variational autoencoders to generate new data and adjust the imbalance of datasets into more favorable balanced datasets. We then use the generated balanced datasets to reduce the deviation of classifiers (incurred by data imbalance) in training and, as a result, to enhance the performance of intrusion detection. As experimental results exhibit, in comparison to unbalanced datasets, balanced datasets can practically lead to better classification accuracy, especially when facing unknown attacks. Balanced datasets also help to solve the over-fitting problem (due to imbalance of datasets) in intrusion detection model training, to ensure that the trained intrusion detection model will not misjudge new types of data - even if they are not in the training dataset.

articleTitle: A Deep Convolutional Neural Network Learning Transfer to SVM-Based Segmentation Method for Brain Tumor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Brain tumor segmentation plays an important role in assisting diagnosis, planning treatment and surgical navigation. In this paper, we propose a convolutional neural network-based learning transfer to support vector machine classifier method for brain tumor segmentation. Our algorithm is composed of two cascaded stages. In the first stage, we trained CNN to learn the mapping from the image space to the tumor label space. During the testing phase, we used the predicted label output from CNN and sent it along with the testing image to an SVM classifier for accurate segmentation. Then we iterate our deep CNN-SVM classifier. Experiments and comparisons demonstrate that the proposed framework is better than the separate SVM-based segmentation or CNN-based segmentation.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based Rapid Electroencephalography Signal Classification System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Based on the feature recognition and classification of motor imagery (MI) electroencephalography (EEG) signals, this paper proposes a field-programmable gate array (FPGA) accelerator system that combines flexibility and reconfigurability for different convolutional neural network (CNN) structures. Applying the synchronous dataflow (SDF) model to an embedded system and configuring the IP cores of each layer separately, a 16-bit fixed-point CNN is finally implemented on PYNQ for EEG classification. Our algorithm shows an 80.5% average accuracy applying data set I in BCI Competition database IV. Compared with PC, designed FPGA increases the speed by 8 times and much lower power consumption. This study provides a CNN accelerator implementation for EEG classification based on the FPGA, which providing a new neural network solution for the application of embedded control systems.

articleTitle: Radar Emitter Signal Detection with Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a deep convolutional neural network (CNN) based automatic detection algorithm for recognizing radar emitter signals. The algorithm leverages on the structure estimation power of deep CNN and the capability of time-frequency image processing for radio signal representation. We transform raw radio signals into time-frequency image using the Choi-Williams distribution function. We compare the proposed method with Belief Propagation (BP) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) based methods in terms of recognition accuracy versus signal-to-noise-ratio. The experiments demonstrate that the proposed CNN network with time-frequency image processing achieves very competitive results on the testing datasets.

articleTitle: Epileptogenic Region Detection Based on Deep CNN with Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The Epileptic seizure can be detected using Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals. It is important for the detection of Epilepsy disease that the detection of epileptogenic region in brain. The focal signal is the signals which from epileptogenic region in brain and the non-focal signal is the signals which from normal regions in brain. Hence, It is important for Epilepsy to detect the focal signal. This paper proposes an automatic detection and diagnosis of EEG signals for Epilepsy disease based on deep learning structure and transfer learning. However, the EEG datasets are usually too small to train the entire deep learning structure. It is easy to be trapped into overfitting during training. Therefore, the transfer learning was introduced to train the deep neural network. Firstly, we obtained the pre-trained AlexNet structure. Then, the parameters of the last three layers were replaced with random weights and the rest parameters served as the initial values. Finally, we used the EEG dataset to train the modified model. Experimental results show that the method attained accuracy of 95.00%, which outperformed state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: Epileptic EEG Identification Based on Deep Bi-LSTM Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Automatic seizure detection has significance for the diagnosis of epilepsy and the reduction of massive workload for neuroscientists. In the analysis of electroencephalogram (EEG) to achieving the goal of detecting seizure activity automatically, in this paper, we proposed a novel algorithm. First, the original signal is filtered into a band-pass filter and the linear features are calculated; Then, deep neural network - bidirectional long-short term memory network (Bi-LSTM) is used to train and classify features. Ultimately, obtained the specificity is 97.14%, the sensitivity is 100%, the G-mean is 98.56% and the average accuracy is 98.56%. The experimental results show that the proposed method has good performance and potential for clinical application.

articleTitle: Pulmonary Nodules Detection Based on CNN Multi-scale Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Early diagnosis of lung cancer can effectively reduce the mortality, lung nodules is an early manifestation of lung cancer, so the use of computer aided detection of lung nodules has been rapidly developed, which quickly and accurately locate the exact location of lung nodules is a challenging work. In this paper, a two-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN) based pulmonary nodules detection framework is proposed. The detection framework consists of two parts: region proposal generation and false positive reduction. First, take the first 10 layers of VGG16 as the basic feature extraction network, and select three feature layers in the last several layers of VGG16 network to generate candidate anchors. Secondly, deconvolution is added between feature layers to fuse higher-order feature information and further generate object categories and precise object locations and sizes, and the final result was selected through non-maximum suppression to reduce false positives. Experiments on LUNA16 dataset show that the average sensitivity of nodule detection is 82.62%, which indicates the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation of Pulmonary Radiology Reports with Semantic Tags
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The chest X-ray is widely used in clinical practice for diagnosis and treatment. Among all chest diseases, pulmonary disease accounts for the majority, and the description of the lungs in the radiology report is the most complicated. According to this situation, this paper proposes a pulmonary radiology report generation model (SRN+BC-LSTM) based on semantic tags of radiograph. Firstly, for the problem that the image features extracted by CNN do not contain obvious semantic information, this paper selects the high frequency words related to abnormalities in the pulmonary radiology report as semantic tags, and trains the multi-label classifier. Secondly, a binary classifier is combined to improve the BLEU of generated normal reports since the Chinese radiology reports have roughly the same description for the normal samples. The experiment results indicated that our model is 13% higher than the baseline model in BLUE4.

articleTitle: Design of Localization System Based on Ultra-Wideband and Long Range Wireless
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: To solve the problem of low accuracy in indoor positioning based on the WiFi, Bluetooth, infrared technologies, a high accuracy indoor positioning system using ultra-wideband (UWB) and long range (LoRa) wireless technologies is designed. The system adopts double-sided two-way ranging(DS-TWR) method and time of arrival (TOA) inner triangle centroid optimization algorithms to enhance its ranging and positioning accuracy, and uses LoRa to conduct wireless data transmission between base stations. The simulation test has shown that the design works stably in building corridors, rooms, and warehouses. The system is able to keep its positioning error within 15cm, which is one-tenth the inaccuracy rate of its WiFi and Bluetooth counterparts in similar settings, and can effectively satisfy the mobile positioning needs of a complex indoor environment.

articleTitle: A Study on the Effects of Distance Learning and the Application of 5G Technolog
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Compared with 4G and previous wireless communication technologies, 5G can provide more learning data to help future deep learning in the form of a converged network. In the past, there were many places that could not be broken in digital distance teaching. All of them would be better improved due to advances in technology. This kind of learning technology can be used to provide future teaching optimization, and can be used to collect learning. Data, data analysis of different learning, digital teaching has more artificial intelligence and interaction mechanism. Through the development of 5G technology, it is expected to improve the network transmission speed of mobile communication, while reducing delay, increasing reliability, and also for various far From the development of teaching network teaching tools, bring more in-depth learning materials collection, provide future use of VR, AR) for teaching use, this study will explore and test the learning effectiveness of hybrid distance teaching, and further through 5G The technology is a link that provides a mechanism for constructing digital deep learning and big data collection in the future, so that future learners can have a more realistic experience, thus improving the effectiveness of digital deep learning.

articleTitle: Research on the Development Trend and Auditing Mode of High Security Enterprise Intranet Security Audit
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Security auditing is an effective means of safety supervision and risk self-identification. It is also a hot issue in the research of major enterprises and institutions. The existing standard norms cannot effectively guide the internal audit of the enterprise intranet, “how to review” and “review” What is not easy to grasp. This paper analyzes the status quo, problems and development trends of security audit, and proposes a behavior-based security audit mode, which can effectively discover the non-compliance behavior of intranet users, and can provide reference for peers through practice.

articleTitle: An Improved Sauvola Approach on QR Code Image Binarization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The paper presents a novel QR code image binarization method to deal with uneven illumination. Our method is based on an adaptive local binarization approach proposed by J. Sauvola. For different illumination condition, it chooses different rule to select the threshold used to distinguish foreground and background. It can use adaptive window size based on lighting condition while calculating mean and standard deviation. The proposed method uses a specific dataset for evaluation and is compared across multiple methods. The experimental results show that the new binarization method can be done with high accuracy and stability, and it is obviously superior to the preceding ways.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Sequence Interception Based on Feature Point Movement
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Automatic and accurate Facial Expression Sequence Interception (FESI) for the face video is an enormous challenge to Facial Expression Recognition (FER). This paper proposes a framework for FESI by the relative movement between facial feature points. Firstly, Active Appearance Model (AAM) is used to mark the feature points and the most representative 24 of them are chosen. Secondly, the intraframe Euclidean distances between any two feature points are calculated and the interframe Euclidean distances variation polylines are fitted, thus the slopes of different segments in the polylines are obtained. Finally, facial expression sequence is intercepted from the face video by determining two key frames whose emotional intensities are minimum and maximum, respectively. Corresponding experiments on Beihang University (BHU) facial expression database and MMI facial expression database are conducted whose results have shown the satisfactory interception effect of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Real-Time Data Processing in Sparse SAR Imaging
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Sarsity-driven synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging has already shown the superiority in terms of imaging performance improvement and image recovery from down-sampled data. However, conventional observation matrix based approach generally requires inhibitive memory space for the target recovery especially for the large-scale scenes. Although azimuth-range decouple based method significantly reduces the computational cost of sparse SAR imaging, it also needs one or two orders more computing time than typical matched filtering (MF) based algorithm, which does not allow the real-time processing. Therefore, further minimizing the computational cost of sparse SAR imaging is needed. In this paper, we present a novel imaging technique that supports real-time data processing in sparse SAR imaging. With experimental results on real data, the presented method is very useful for achieving desired imaging performance in practical applications, and has been successfully reduced the computational time to the same order as MF based method.

articleTitle: Cross-Domain Variational Autoencoder for Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of sparse data and user cold start in a single domain for collaborative filtering, this paper proposes a cross-domain recommendation model called cross-domain variational autoencoder (CDVAE) based on Bayesian theory. The model uses rating data to construct latent representations of users and items in multiple domains, utilizes overlapping users in different domains, and draws on the idea of variational autoencoder (VAE) to train a user generating networks cross-domains based on user preferences to different domains. Bayesian theory is introduced to ensure the generation ability and robustness of the model. Finally, based on the user’s preference to the source domain, the user’s preference prediction in the target domain is obtained. The generation of the recommendation result is obtained by the user’s preference weighting in the source domain and the target domain, and the user’s multi-source interest preference is considered to improve the accuracy. The experimental results show that CDVAE is able to significantly outperform the state-of-the-art recommendation methods of more robust performance.

articleTitle: Reassembly of Two-Dimensional Irregular Fragments by Improved Polygon Feature Matching
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Automatic reassembly of fragments by computer is necessary when the number of fragments is large and mixed with each other for reconstruction by artificial contrast is complicated and time-consuming. In order to achieve 2D irregular fragments reassembly, a new reassembly method of 2D fragments based on contours is proposed. Firstly, the spatial adjacent fragment pairs are found by using the improved local matching method for polygon features, and the matching degree of each pair is measured. Then a new path-generating method is given based on matching angle. By generating the global path and reassembling the fragments according to the path, the multi-fragment reassembly is finally realized. Simulation results show that this method can make full use of the local matching results to obtain ideal reassembly results. And the calculation amount can be greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Fiber Nonlinearity Mitigation in Long-Haul Coherent Optical Transmission Systems : Invited Paper
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Fiber nonlinearities from Kerr effect are considered as major constraints for enhancing the transmission capacity in current optical transmission systems. Digital nonlinearity compensation techniques such as digital backpropagation can perform well but require high computing resources. Machine learning can provide a low complexity capability especially for high-dimensional classification problems. Recently several supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques have been investigated in the field of fiber nonlinearity mitigation. This paper offers a brief review of the principles, performance and complexity of these machine learning approaches in the application of nonlinearity mitigation.

articleTitle: De-noising of 3D Pulse Images by Channel-Weighted Robust Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: learning (artificial intelligence); medical image processing; convolutional neural nets; feature extraction; neural nets; image segmentation; electroencephalography; image classification; medical signal processing; 5G mobile communication.

articleTitle: A Novel Nuclei Segmentation Algorithm Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of medical diagnostic techniques, the segmentation of the nucleus has important diagnostic significance in the examination of clinical pathology. However, as the clinical proportion increases, the traditional segmentation technique (manual segmentation) becomes a cumbersome and unstable method because of its time consuming and the technical level of the pathologists. On the other hand, the detection of nuclear equipment required for manual segmentation is extremely expensive and the requirements of the operating environment are badly demanding. Compared with traditional image processing technology, deep learning based segmentation technology can better summarize the appearance of nuclei. At present, the most prominent deep learning semantic segmentation network architecture is U-Net. Here, in this paper we propose a novel convolutional neural network combined with the existing segmentation technologies to independently learn the pixel-level prior information in the nuclei. The special connection method adopted by its internal structure can extract the scale information of different network layers. The proposed architecture is compared with the classical U-Net and its transforms on nuclei dataset from kaggle data science bowl 2018 dataset fixes. Experiments show that the proposed method shows higher performance than other networks in accuracy, Jaccard index and F1 score. Our network has more prominent advantages for the treatment of irregular nuclei.

articleTitle: iReportMo: An Emergency Report Android Mobile Application for Metro Manila
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Geographical Information System helps everyone in many industries on a regular basis. “iReportMo” is an android mobile application that uses GIS-based to let a citizen report an incident right from the mobile device. This application will serve as an easy access that caters emergency concern such as fire, accident, crime and barangay incident in Metro manila. The user may provide details such as location, date, time, and images when reporting an incident. There are few existing literatures have focused on providing assistance to any emergency event using the newest technology, but few have not touched on providing a centralized system that caters all the emergency in one application. Thus, this paper automates the efforts of the manual transaction to effectively respond to an emergency hazard in City of Manila thus makes it more efficient to gather important information in real time.

articleTitle: ESPI Images Denoising Based on Improved Total Variation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Image denoising is a key step for image processing. The real electronic speckle pattern interference (ESPI) fringe pattern contains massive speckle noise, which can affect the image quality. To solve the problem of staircase effect and reduce the speckle noise, a new method for ESPI image denoising, which is an improved adaptive total variation (TV) denoising method based on the block-matching and 3D filtering (BM3D) algorithm, is proposed. This method combines the advantages of BM3D denoising method and adaptive TV elimination staircase effect. The image which has been smoothed by the BM3D as the new fidelity item is used and combined with the adaptive total variation denoising model to denoise the electronic speckle interference fringe pattern. Experiment results show that the proposed method has better noise filtering effect and the structure of the speckle fringe pattern is well maintained. Thus the appearance of the staircase effect can be reduced and the details, texture and edge information of the image can be preserved at a large level.

articleTitle: 5G Small Cell Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the detection method of 5G small cell. Firstly define the 5G small cell and propose three modules tests includes RF performance test, RF radiation index test and antenna test for 5G small cell detection. Pointed out that OTA test is a new way to measure radiofrequency radiation index and describe the OTA test of radiofrequency radiation in details.

articleTitle: Single Image Super-Resolution Based on Cascaded Recursive Residual Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The accurate and automatic reconstruction of a super-resolution image from one single low-resolution image is an important challenging problem for image analysis. In this paper, we have optimized the problems of existing methods and presented an automated super-resolution image reconstruction system from a single low-resolution image based on cascaded recursive residual convolutional neural network. In this method, we extracted the characteristics of images firstly, then used recursive networks to connect the feature information of each layer to obtain three residual images. Finally, the high-resolution image was obtained by applying the deconvolution at the end of network. we used the recursive structure applying to the residual learning, this network differed from traditional residual learning in that the structure and overlay of the remaining learning network are different, it can solved the problem of gradient explosion, overfitting and insufficient transmission of high frequency component. Compared with present four methods, our algorithm had good performance in experiment of super-resolution testing. Experimental results showed that the proposed method could recover the fine details and textures, simultaneously, it has satisfactory performance in PSNR values.

articleTitle: Application of Internet of Things Positioning System Based on LoRa System to Community Correction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: With the development of Internet of Things technology, outdoor positioning technology has been investigating extensively. Based on the brief analysis and comparison of the advantages and disadvantages of various tracking systems designed for community correction targets, this paper proposes to establish a LoRa outdoor positioning system used for community correction based on TDOA algorithm with low power consumption. The experimental results show that this system can achieve a positioning accuracy of 40m (with 95% confidence coefficient). This paper analyzes and summarizes the advantages of the system which is applicable to community correction and able to meet the requirements for tracking the correction targets.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Segmentation from MRI Using Pre-segmentation Based on Superpixels and Fully Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: This paper focuses on the development of an effective method for brain tumor segmentation in MR image, which includes two novel approaches. The first approach is an image pre-segmentation algorithm using superpixels for brain tumor segmentation in T1-w, T1-c, T2-w and FLAIR, respectively. We use pre-segmentation as the rough segmentation of the image to get the region of interest (ROI). The images of each subject were already aligned with the T1c and skull stripped. The second segmentation approach is based on Fully Convolutional Network. The performance evaluation for the proposed method is based on MRI data sets of Medical Image Computing and Computer Aided Intervention Society (MICCAI) 2017 Brain Tumor Segmentation Challenge. The numerical results are presented in terms of true positive rate (TPR), positive predictive value (PPV) and Dice coefficient (DICE) for GD-enhancing tumor (ET), tumor core (TC) and whole tumor (WT), respectively, which are the major three components concerned by medical doctor in diagnosis and treatment planning for brain tumor. A comparison of the proposed method and the expert manual method, as well as the other conventional method shows that the proposed method is able to acquire a larger mean value of the Dice similarity coefficient than the other conventional methods do. Therefore, this novel method is an added value for the clinical radiology of brain tumor.

articleTitle: Structure Importance-Aware Hidden Images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Hidden images are fascinating as they present viewers a visual phenomenon of perceiving latent illusion from a single image. Recently, several solutions for automatically generating hidden images have been developed in the computer graphics community. While these solutions produce visually appealing hidden results, structure importance of the hidden object is rarely taken into account. In this paper, an automatic algorithm is presented to generate such images by integrating structure importance analysis of the hidden objects. Our algorithm is motivated by the law of closure of Gestalt psychology theory, indicating that human still can recognize an object from incomplete structural edges. We model the problem as a conditional image composition and approach it through a two-stage pipeline. The algorithm first performs a structure analysis to find the structure importance map of the object. Then the importance map is combined into a conditional mean value composition to generate the hidden image. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can efficiently generate visually appealing hidden images. Moreover, a user study is conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the Model of 5G Front-Haul Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In 5G bearer network, the front-haul requires a large number of optical fibers. In order to construct 5G front-haul network with high cost performance ratio, this paper studied the architecture and networking scheme of 5G front-haul network, established cost calculation model and analyzed it. The result shows as long as the appropriate DU concentration, DU location and the appropriate convergent optical cable are selected, it will set up cost-effective 5G front-haul network.

articleTitle: Hybrid System of Convolutional Neural Networks and SVM for Multi-class MIEEG Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Deep learning methods are used in the field of brain-computer interface (BCI). We propose a model that combines convolution neural networks (CNNs) and support vector machines (SVMs) for multi-classification based on the use of motor imagery technique. The Stockwell transform is used to transform signals into feature maps covering different frequency ranges. Here, the feature map is input into CNN for conducting feature extraction, and the SVM is used as a classifier to classify the feature secondary training extracted by the CNN to form a complete MI processing framework. Batch normalization and drop layer are added to the CNN network to improve the over-fitting phenomenon that may occur. The sliding Gaussian time window enhances the data samples to improve the classification performance of the network. The superiority of the model is demonstrated through the results of the tests conducted on the BCI Competition IV dataset 2a. The average cross-validation accuracy rates of CNN and CNN-SVM are 82% and 84.1%, and the Kappa values are 0.76 and 0.79, respectively. The accuracy rate and Kappa value of CNN-SVM increased by 2.1% and 0.03, respectively. Experimental results show that the classification performance of CNN-SVM is higher than that of CNN and most existing classification algorithms.

articleTitle: The Application of the Internet of Things Technology in Apple Production
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: To improve the yield and quality of apples, reduce the management cost in apple orchard, the introduction of the Internet of Things (IOT) technology in fruit tree management can perceive every segment in fruit tree management and provide the basic data support. The IOT technology can help to monitor the environment information of apple orchards and the detailed data of apple growth, which is useful for management suggestion and planting decision. Therefore, the application of IOT technology in apple orchard can make the apple tree management more scientific and intelligent.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Light Distribution and Fluctuation Characteristics under Different Weather Conditions in Xi’an Area
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Laser transmission experiment with a link length of 2500m was carried out in Xi’an region at night. Which studied the statistical characteristics of irradiance scintillation in overcast, sunny, rainy, snowy and smoggy weather. The intensity distribution law of the spot was analyzed through the method of Three-dimensional pseudo-color visualization. The refractive index structure constants of the atmosphere under different weather conditions were measured by scintillation method, and the intensity variation was measured. The Irradiance scintillation characteristics were analyzed by Rytov variance. The results show that: The intensity of the spot obeys the Gaussian distribution. Near geometric center of light spots, the steepness of light spots is the largest in sunny days, followed by overcast days, while rainy days and snowy days are relatively gentle. The maximum light intensity of light spots decreases gradually in the order of sunny days,overcast days, smoggy days, rainy days and snowy days. The fluctuation degree of scintillation index in sunny days is the largest, and t he fluctuation of light intensity in the most time of sunny days belongs to the medium fluctuation area, while the fluctuation of light intensity in the most time of smoggy days, rainy days, snowy days and overcast days belongs to the weak fluctuation area.

articleTitle: Prediction and Analysis of Pseudomonas Aeruginosa Promoters Based on Sequence Features
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Although a great deal of research has been undertaken for promoter prediction, many algorithms tend to exhibit unsatisfied specificity. Most of the existing prokaryotic promoter researches are designed for Escherichia coli. Here, we built a predictor based on sequence-based features for identifying promoters in Pseudomonas aeruginosa. The results indicate that our model can recognize the promoter from non-promoters with high precision. The DNA sequence is also the carrier of information transmission, which inspired us to analyze promoter sequence longitudinally by adopting the signal processing method. We combined with an artificial neural network to build a promoter prediction model. The performance of the model was tested by 5-fold cross-validation. The results showed that the method proposed here achieved an area under curve of 90%, suggesting that the powerful ability of this model for promoter recognition in P. aeruginosa.

articleTitle: Average Associating Rate Modeling in Hyper-Dense Heterogeneous Wireless Cell Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Hyper-dense multi-tier heterogeneous cell networks (HetNets) is one of most active and promising areas in modern wireless communication researches, to cater to the explosive demand of wireless communication and QoS assurance. User associating rate in HetNets is one of QoS key metrics. In this paper, HetNets is modeled with Stochastic Geometry (SG), and the tagged user is associated one of BSs in HetNets based on the nearest distance and maximum long-term averaged received power (with biasing). Based on this, a new tractable analytical rate model is proposed with SG technology. Numerical results show that our proposed associating rate model represents a significant improvement over literature model.

articleTitle: An Empirical Evaluation on Word Embeddings Across Reading Comprehension
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Word embeddings which is real-valued word representation able to capture lexical semantics plays a crucial role in machine reading comprehension tasks because the first step is the embedding of the question and the passage. One of the frequently-used models is Word2Vec, but several fashionable competitors have been proposed in recent years, including GloVe and Fasttext. However the question which word embedding model really performs best and is most suitable across different reading comprehension tasks remains unanswered to this date. In this paper we performed the first extrinsic empirical evaluation of three word embeddings across four types of tasks: Multiple Choice, Cloze, Answer Extraction and Conversation. The experiments showed that GloVe and Fasttext have their own strengths in different type of tasks: The accuracy of Multiple Choice task improves significantly when leveraging GloVe, Fasttext is a bit more suitable for Answer Extraction task, and GloVe performs similarly with Fasttext in Cloze task and Conversation task. Finally, we find that Word2Vec has been demoded compared with GloVe and Fasttext in all tasks.

articleTitle: An Effective Personnel Detection System Based on Radio Frequency Identification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In privacy scenarios, the camera based personnel detection is usually not feasible. To this end, we present a radio frequency identification (RFID) based personnel detection approach in this paper, which can not only avoid the privacy violation problem, but also have the advantage of low cost, strong practicability and easy implementation. Specifically, the passive RFID tags are placed on the walls with a fixed distance, which can return the received signal strength indication (RSSI). Signals are received through the RFID antenna, and data are processed preliminarily by the RFID reader. With the collected data, a machine learning model is trained, and then used to detect the existence of people in a stable and reliable approach. Our experiments show that the detection accuracy of the proposed approach is approximately 99%.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Model for Transportation Efficiency of Equipment Based on Subjective and Objective Combination Weighting Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: This paper creates the evaluation index system for transportation efficiency of equipment by analyzing the influencing factors of evaluation on transportation efficiency of equipment; introduces combination weighting method, combines the subjective and objective weight values calculated with the analytic hierarchy process and the rough theory using the variance maximization theory, obtains the combination weight value of evaluation index of transportation efficiency of equipment, and constructs a multi-factor overall evaluation model of transportation efficiency of equipment on this basis to prove the feasibility of the model by an example. The model for evaluation on transportation efficiency of equipment based on subjective and objective combination weighting method in this paper is more scientific and reasonable than the evaluation model with single weight calculation method, which lays a foundation for further research on transportation efficiency of equipment.

Author Keywords: evaluation on transportation efficiency of equipment

articleTitle: Deep Investigation of Coherent Integral Acquisition Algorithm of GNSS Signals
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Autonomous navigation places an extremely high demand on the acquisition sensitivity of the global navigation satellite system (GNSS) receivers. To increase the efficiency and sensitivity of the acquisition algorithm of GNSS weak signal, we improve the acquisition algorithm named Improved Acquisition Algorithm with Doppler Frequency Compensation (IAADFC) proposed in our previous study. We provide a detailed analysis and comparison among the proposed IAADFC algorithm, non coherent integration (NCI) algorithm and double block zero padding (DBZP) algorithm. Simulation results show that the weak signal acquisition ability of IAADFC algorithm and DBZP algorithm can be improved by increasing the coherent integration time CIT and the acquisition sensitivity of IAADFC algorithm is higher than that of the DBZP algorithm. What's more, the acquisition sensitivity of IAADFC algorithm and DBZP algorithm can be significantly improved by estimating and correcting navigation message bit flip or transition using DBST algorithm.

Author Keywords: Improved Acquisition Algorithm with Doppler Frequency Compensation (IAADFC)

articleTitle: An Efficient Broadcast Relay in Support of FANETs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: A Lemma addressing the conditions to achieve the upper bound of coverage for both single-hop and multiple-hop broadcast relay on demand basis in support of flying ad hoc networks (FANETs) is presented. Based on this Lemma, a novel directional broadcasting approach is proposed for flying unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) node to search for suitable rebroadcasting node in the defined symmetrical area without any requirement on UAV's location information. This novel approach is designed to support a group of mission based UAVs networks in flying environment, where the radio communication between UAVs has to be performed on demand basis and UAVs are lack of accurate location information due to limited electricity power and payload capacity. The numerical results show that the proposed approach is able to increase the successful data delivery ratio of 10-20% and to reduce the number of broadcasting nodes 50% comparing to the performance of the conventional topology-based approach, geometry-based approach and angle-based approach under a condition of UAV flying environment.

articleTitle: Detection of Dibutyl Phthalate (DBP) Content in Liquor Based on Near Infrared Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In recent years, liquor in the domestic market has been deeply affected by the plasticizer (DBP). Some studies have shown that the substance is strongly toxic and is not suitable for liquor additives. Based on the artificially configured DBP samples, this study used a near-infrared spectroscopy quantitative analysis model to predict the DBP content in liquor. Here, 141 different ratios of DBP samples were generated and a 141×1050 original spectral matrix was obtained by scanning with NIRSDS 2500. In the data processing stage, the abnormal samples were removed by the Mahalanobis distances. Then, the sensitive features are extracted by correlation coefficient and principal component analysis (PCA). Finally, a partial least squares (PLS) quantitative analysis model is established. The determination coefficient R2 of the model calibration is 0.89697, and the predicted root mean square error (RMSEP) is 0.02003. The results show that the DBP detection model established by this algorithm is suitable for DBP prediction.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Cervical Exfoliated Cells Based on Faster R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The detection and classification of cervical cells via Pap smear or Liquid-based cytology (LBC) have important clinical significance for pathological diagnosis. For the limitations of pathological images and the complexity of morphological changes of cells, the accurate classification of cervical cells remains a challenging task. DNA ploidy analysis can complete the classification and recognition of individual cells well, and misclassification is common because of the factors of inevitable imaging. Unlike traditional classification methods that rely on manual features, we proposed a region detection and classification method based on multi-semantic label combined with morphological information analysis. We followed the principle that a nucleus represents a cell and divided cells into five categories. The overlapping cell regions could be divided into multiple single cells. In this paper, the data pre-processing was made up for the imbalance in classification. The weight parameters obtained from ImageNet dataset pre-training were realized the transfer learning of cervical exfoliated cells based on Faster R-CNN on LBC dataset. The result showed that the mean average precision (mAP) was 66.98% and the accuracy was 91.61% by learning depth and superficial features of cervical exfoliated cells with ResNet-101 as the backbone. To some extent, it can assist pathologists in the early diagnosis of cervical cancer.

articleTitle: Privacy Preserving Distributed Data Mining Based on Secure Multi-party Computation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Data mining is an important task to understand the valuable information for making right decision. There are numerous mature technologies for mining self-owned data of a party. However, how to perform distributed data mining to obtain information from data owned by multi-party without privacy leak is still a challenge. In recent years, secure multi-party computation (MPC) shows its potential capability for solving this problem. Meanwhile, there are a number of problems to be solved before utilizing in business environment. In this paper, we point out two unsupported tasks of MPC that are common in real-world. Towards this end, we design algorithms based on optimized matrix computation with one-hot encoding and LU decomposition to support these in MPC context requirements. In addition, we implement them based on a SPDZ protocol, a computation framework of MPC. The experimental evaluation results demonstrate that our design and implementation are feasible and effective for privacy preserving distributed data mining.

articleTitle: A Simulation Platform for Software Defined Integrated Space Ground Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Software defined integrated space ground networks are playing an indispensable role in the next generation network. In this paper, we proposed a simulation platform of SDN enabled space ground integrated networks. On this platform, most satellites are switches to forward the data based on flow-tables provided by SDN controllers located on the highest layer to take responsibility of centralized control. In this paper, we analyze the regional coverage performance through STK (Satellite Tool Kit) for the integrated space ground network architecture with multi-layer satellites and the communication analysis is carried out by using the SDN simulation software Mininet. The paper shows that, with collecting congestion status of satellites, this platform has a good performance of optimizing end-to-end delay and packet loss.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Fire Risk for High-Rise Civil Buildings Based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: High-rise and ultra high-rise buildings have solved the problems of limitations caused by construction land to a certain extent, and provided a better view and more convenience for people at the same time. Problems such as high fire loads, difficulties in occupants evacuation and firefighting have become the focus of public and fire departments. This paper constructs a fire risk evaluation indicator system and an AHP-based fire risk evaluation model for high-rise civil buildings. It applies the fuzzy hierarchy theory to the fire risk evaluation for high-rise hotel buildings in a city and provides theoretical support for the prevention and control of these risks.

articleTitle: Image Caption Method Combining Multi-angle with Multi-modality
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Image caption generation technology has attracted the interest of researchers due to its wide application in practical applications. It involves two vital areas of artificial intelligence: image processing and natural language processing. The existing method is to predict the generation of the next word based on the image features and the words generated in the previous state. However, it ignores the important role of text information. In this paper, we propose an image caption generation method that combines multi-angle with multimodality. The model firstly uses the fusion features of the global and local images as input. Picture description of the first sentence is generated using the baseline encoding-decoding model. The image caption which is generated firstly is then input into the sentence encoding network to generate a semantic feature vector of the first sentence. Then, the local visual feature vector of the image and the semantic eigenvector of the first sentence which are two different modal features, are combined and input into the attention-based language generation model to generate the next sentence. This allows our model to generate multi-angle descriptions in a targeted manner.

articleTitle: Research on Image Super-resolution Based on Improved Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 11th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In this paper, an ACT-R (Adaptive Control of Thought-Rational) research model applied to the research of super-resolution reconstruction is constructed. In the matching stage, we add recurrent layer to the underlying convolutional neural network to train an improved end-to-end deep threshold recurrent neural network; In the selection stage, the neighborhood embedding algorithm is used to compensate the residual part of the image. The high resolution residual image with higher pixel density and higher quality detail information is obtained. In the decision-making stage, the reconstructed residual image and the high resolution image obtained by the recurrent convolution layer are integrated to complete the reconstruction of the image super-resolution. The experimental results show that the model has good reconstruction ability to the image and achieved good results in both PSNR and SSIM evaluation criteria.
